issues.title: Missing Viewport Meta Tag
issues.description: No <meta name='viewport'> tag detected. Mobile browsers will render at desktop scale (980px).

issues.remediation: Include a single <h1> heading describing the page purpose.
Add lang='en' (or respective language code) to the root <html> tag.
